name: WatchNotify
description: Watches playback events and, when a movie or episode is watched to completion, sends a Simple Cloud Notifier push and appends a line to a Joplin watch-log note.
overview: Notifies SCN and Joplin when a movie or episode is watched

versions.changelog: Fix a 500 on the status endpoint and a broken settings page that never populated its fields.
First release: SCN push and Joplin watch log as a native Jellyfin plugin.
